textBefore: Hey guys, this is simply the Sins of Seedia leader! As you may know or may not know, my SDU’s one year event will be happening this weekend, and we would love to invite anyone in the federation to it. The event is Sunday, May 6th, 11:00am CST/16:00 UTC, Troms, WC will be announced the day of the event, the theme color is red so if you want to wear a red mc skin that’d be cool too. Please feel free to join us for item bombs, a mythic giveaway and multiple legendary giveaways, a following CSST, speeches, and to celebrate a year of my guild’s success (it wasn’t possible without the support of federation ;D).
Thanks you guys, can’t wait to see you all there!!
